title: Geometry of Curves and Surfaces — Problem 3.1
exact_target: Can every convex polyhedron be cut along its edges into one connected piece that unfolds flat without overlap?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 7000014 (AMR-069-0014). CC BY 4.0.
Mohammad Ghomi, \emph{Affine unfoldings of convex polyhedra}, arXiv:1305.3231v2 (2014), Introduction, pp. 2--4, including Note 1.5; Section 2.1, p. 5.
